items.t: MongoDB faces lower expectations ahead of earnings as Bank of America cuts price target

items.t: How MongoDB Survived a CEO Shakeup to Become a Quiet AI Play
items.sum: UBS, Oppenheimer, and KeyBanc are all positive on the document database stock, despite the sudden departure of its top leader in September.

items.t: MongoDB Stocks Jump 6.68% as UBS Upgrade Bets on AI Workloads
items.sum: UBS moved to buy, citing steady demand and a possible role in 20% to 40% of incremental AI workloads.

items.t: MongoDB Atlas for Government Secures FedRAMP High Certification Across Three Major Cloud Platforms
items.sum: MongoDB, Inc. (NASDAQ:MDB) announced that its Atlas for Government platform has achieved FedRAMP Class D (High) certification and expanded support to Microsoft Azure Government, enabling US government agencies to deploy the database service across three major cloud providers.

items.t: MongoDB Atlas for Government Achieves FedRAMP® Class D (High) Certification, Adds Support for Microsoft Azure Government
items.sum: MongoDB, Inc. (NASDAQ: MDB) today announced that MongoDB Atlas for Government has achieved FedRAMP® Class D (formerly known as FedRAMP High) Certification and added support for Azure Government.
